chunks: Himalayan Solar makes solar PV modules in Panchkula, Haryana, selling mainly to government departments and contractors.
Its 40 megawatt polycrystalline line ran until August 2024, when new efficiency norms for government tenders shifted demand to Mono-PERC modules.
It has letters of intent for 50 megawatt of Mono-PERC modules and plans to move into solar EPC.
